'''Heat radiator shrouds''' were components used in [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] to prevent overheating. The [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DH-23 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-23 blaster pistol]] had a more effective heat radiator shroud included in design than the earlier [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]].<ref name="AAEG" />
